title: Shared test harness, fixture, and surface-parity helper family
problemStatement: Several CI smoke tests were repeating the same harness logic: create a temp root, reserve a --json output path, run a Node gate script with a test env, read the JSON payload back, and clean up. The repo already had lower-level helpers like tests/helpers/run-node.js and tests/helpers/test-env.js, but no cohesive helper for this recurring JSON gate harness pattern.

duplicateClusters.name: CI gate smoke tests with tempRoot/jsonPath/spawn/read/cleanup repetition
duplicateClusters.bestFix: Create one small JSON gate harness that composes the existing run-node, test-env, and JSON-file helpers instead of letting each smoke test rebuild the same lifecycle.

whyCurrentSharedModulesWereInsufficient: tests/helpers/run-node.js handled process execution but not temp-root/json-path lifecycle or payload loading.
tests/helpers/test-env.js handled env shaping but not script execution or payload capture.
src/shared/json-file.js handled JSON file IO but not the test-side orchestration around gate scripts.

nonGoals: Wrap every test process launch in a new framework abstraction.
Replace high-signal local helpers where sharing would reduce clarity.
Absorb fixture builders, API harnesses, and parity harnesses into one giant helper.
followOnDeletionTargets: Migrate other gate-style smoke tests that match the same JSON harness shape.
Keep more specialized parity and fixture harnesses separate unless a similarly tight repeated family appears.
